name: Abu Sayed
contribution: A Begum Rokeya University student activist, he was shot dead by police in Rangpur on 16 July 2024 during quota-reform protests.
impact: His killing became a major trigger for nationwide escalation and a defining symbol of the July uprising.
highlight: His death transformed a policy protest into a nationwide justice movement.
